author: DeadEyeDick
text_post: On the one hand, many people experience depression due, in part, to a lack of satisfying relationships. Since this method teaches you how to meet and attract women, the increased interaction with others might make you temporarily feel better. Also, if you were to progress, the successes might increase your feelings of confidence and self-worth. On the other hand, early game involves learning how to handle rejection, which can occur often as you begin to open sets. It happens to everyone, no matter how experienced they are. However, these rejections can hurt worse if you're depressed, and reinforce negative views a depressed person may already have about himself.  Those hurts do not go away quickly or easily when you're depressed.  Working on becoming less depressed will help you in all areas of your life. And there many causes of depression. If I were to prioritize what kind of learning would be best to do first, it would be to work on easing the causes of the depression. Because everything will get easier after that.  You should seek professional help, as the Forum is not a great place for getting help with longstanding psychological challenges. See a counselor. And if they sell it where you live, get The Feeling Good Handbook by David Burns, MD. It's good chit.  Good luck.
